entities.summary: Wilfrid Fox Napier, O.F.M. is a South African Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Durban from 1992 to 2021. He was made a cardinal in 2001. He served as Bishop of Kokstad from 1981 to 1992 and is a member of the Order of Friars Minor. Wilfrid Napier was a religious figures from Western Cape (b. 1941-03-08, Western Cape).
